rule: ADR-0042 §8.1: admit a multi-row head phrase iff it names a food or ingredient a person would type into a food log; exclude heads that name a category of foods. Applied by hand to all 271 multi-row heads; 150 admitted.
cut: §8.1 expected ~50 and the rule admitted 150, so the gold set is the stated stratified cut recorded in the note amendment: every admitted head a candidate shape can reach (22), plus #143 named cases not otherwise reached (4), plus a seeded fill from the remaining admitted heads (24). Seed 143, the repo seededPick convention.

not_typed: soy sauce made from soy and wheat shoyu

verdicts_are: unset until adjudication; every case carries verdict:null and should_lead:null here BY DESIGN, committed before a single case was read

cases.head: almond milk
cases.lead_today: Almond milk, unsweetened, plain, shelf stable
cases.should_lead: Almond milk, unsweetened, plain, shelf stable
cases.note: Shelf-stable and refrigerated are the same product; neither is more canonical.

cases.head: arugula
cases.note: Arugula, raw leads.

cases.head: bacon
cases.note: The plain cured bacon is tier-blocked at rank 8 because its head is 'Pork'. Within the tie, demoting the reduced-sodium lead promotes 'Bacon, meatless' — a substitute — so the modifier list is INCOMPLETE, not wrong.

cases.head: bagels
cases.should_lead: Bagels, plain, with calcium propionate (includes onion, poppy, sesame)
cases.note: Plain should lead a bare 'bagels'. Not reachable: the lead 'Bagels, wheat' carries no marker.

cases.head: bamboo shoots
cases.note: Raw leads.

cases.head: bananas
cases.note: 'overripe' is a modifier the candidate list does not carry.

readjudicated.lead_now: Bananas, ripe and slightly ripe, raw
readjudicated.note: The miss is resolved rather than moved. 'overripe' was a modifier no candidate shape carried, and no shape was needed: the merge had discarded SR Legacy's `Bananas, raw`, and carrying it as an alias (ADR-0050) gives the surviving row a name ending in ', raw' — simplicity 3 against the 2 that had been winning.

cases.head: beef
cases.note: Separable fat is the sharpest §3.1 wrongness: a fraction leading the food.

cases.head: butter
cases.note: Ghee leads. 'light' and 'whipped' are modifiers the candidate list does not carry.

cases.head: cheese
cases.lead_today: Cheese, cottage, lowfat, 1% milkfat, lactose reduced

cases.head: chicken
cases.lead_today: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin and giblets and neck
cases.note: 'meat and skin and giblets and neck' IS the whole bird, which §3.1 ranks first. The part key would DEMOTE it — a regression the candidate list creates.

cases.head: cowpeas
cases.should_lead: Cowpeas, common (blackeyes, crowder, southern), mature seeds
cases.note: The part key fires on 'seeds' and would promote 'leafy tips' — which is itself a part. Worse, not better.

cases.head: egg
cases.note: Leads with a duck egg. NB there is NO plain fresh shell-egg row in the corpus; the designated row is the best available, not the right one.

cases.should_lead: Eggs, Grade A, Large, egg whole
cases.note: White and yolk are parts; whole is the food. Not reachable: 'egg white' is not in the part list.

cases.head: spinach
cases.lead_today: Spinach, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
cases.note: Cooked leads. 'Spinach, raw' is in BOTH archives and neither copy ships (#130 §8) — this designation is the best row LEFT, and #137 may change it.

readjudicated.note: This case's own note said #137 might change it, and it did. #130 §8's premise was wrong: SR Legacy's `Spinach, raw` (168462) shares ndb 11457 with Foundation's `Spinach, mature` and merges into it, so raw spinach was in the corpus all along. Carrying the discarded name as a search alias (ADR-0050) lets the `raw` key decide this two rungs above the plain one. `should_lead: Spinach, baby` was the best row LEFT under a false premise; the row that leads now is the food itself.

adjudication.by: LLM, one case at a time, against #130 §3.1 precedence and §3.2 vocabulary
adjudication.ratification: WAIVED 2026-08-21 at the maintainer's direction. §8.3 required a human to read all 50 before a key was written; the review tool built for it was removed and the step skipped. These verdicts are LLM-proposed and independently unread. The key shipped anyway; see ADR-0042's #143 Amendment.

repinned: 2026-09-13: every case gained the `fdcId` of the row it names, and the descriptions were re-read off the corpus. The uncooked-corpus change renamed most of these rows (`Arugula, raw` -> `Arugula`), and this file was keyed on DESCRIPTION alone - so a harness asking whether a head still leads with its recorded row silently skipped 18 of the 19 adjudicated-correct cases and reported no breakage because it had checked almost nothing. #188 keys its own set by `fdcId` for exactly this reason. `lead_dropped` marks a case whose row has left the corpus.
